platforms.name: Superteam Earn
platforms.scope: Read-only agent-eligible catalogue discovery; not a recommendation to solve current out-of-lane listings.

publicDiscovery.pagination: Public UI endpoint has no pagination parameter in QueryParamsSchema; returns all matching agent-context rows. Do not claim unlimited future completeness.
publicDiscovery.agentPolicy: Only AGENT_ALLOWED or AGENT_ONLY; independently validate client-side. context=agents also enforces verified sponsor server-side.

parameters.deadline: ISO date/datetime lowerbound clamped to now
parameters.excludeIds[]: repeat IDs to fetch further batches; no skip supported

agentApi.registration: Owner-approved POST /api/agents creates agent profile, API key and claim code. NOT performed.

platforms.payoutModel: Sponsor-selected bounty/hackathon awards or project acceptance; token varies per listing. Human talent profile and verified wallet payout claim; no guaranteed escrow or payment.
platforms.assignmentModel: Bounties/hackathons are competitive submissions, not reservations. Projects have application/selection and listing-specific terms; confirm assignment before substantial solve.
platforms.aiPolicy: Explicit agent flow for AGENT_ALLOWED/AGENT_ONLY; HUMAN_ONLY excluded. No reuse of competitors submissions.
platforms.competitionVisibility: Public _count.Submission and Comments; count is not acceptance probability.
platforms.geographicConstraints: Listing-specific regional eligibility; example Vietnam track page labels Global but full requirements still need review. Platform terms exclude sanctioned/prohibited jurisdictions. Kuwait-specific token-payout legality/eligibility not established, do not assume it.
platforms.accountKyc: No account needed for public discovery. Agent registration key needed for agent API/submission. Human sign-in, complete talent profile, verified wallet and any required human verification/terms must be owner handled. Agents do not perform OAuth/wallet signing/KYC.
ownerSteps: Review platform and candidate terms plus geographic/payment eligibility before account or reward actions.
When useful listing exists, approve one agent registration and securely store API key server-side; do not paste key or claim code in logs.
Human signs in and completes talent profile; GitHub connection is not required by documented agent API.
Human chooses/verifies supported wallet and completes any required identity checks; do not fabricate payout details.
For projects provide owner Telegram URL if required.
After a win and owner review, human opens /earn/claim/{claimCode} and confirms claim. Agent must not claim on behalf of human.

platforms.name: Gitpay

discovery.schema: Unpaginated array; with limit returns {data,totalCount}; limit,offset or zero-based page supported; hasBounty=true filters value>0.
discovery.privacy: Raw result contains unnecessary user/order/payment identifiers; retained report contains only aggregate task metadata. Do not persist raw payment fields.

platforms.decisionReason: Live platform and technical catalogue verified, but87open records all displayvalue0, fundedfilter empty. No credible current25–300funded task confirmed; AI-agent policy notexplicit. Research now, no adapter merely because endpoint exists.
platforms.paymentCaveat: One Readwise integration record has20USD order labeled succeeded but capturefalse and taskvalue0. Do not turn pending/uncaptured orders into confirmed bounty rewards.
platforms.assignmentModel: Apply and await explicit assignment. Gitpay verifies underlying GitHub assignee before claim confirmation; delivery/acceptance precedes payment request.
platforms.payoutModel: Stripe Connect default; Whop alternative; PayPal for some accounts/older tasks. Funding method and active payout configuration determine route. Country-specific verification/withdrawal eligibility must be confirmed.
platforms.aiPolicy: UNKNOWN: reviewed official docs/terms do not explicitly permit or prohibit autonomous engineering; respect repository rules and obtain confirmation before autonomous participation. Unknown is investigate, not rejection.
platforms.competitionVisibility: Task assigned and Assigns fields plus canonical GitHub issue/PR checks; complete competition not guaranteed.
platforms.geographicConstraints: No blanket country guarantee established. Whop methods depend on country; Stripe/PayPal depend on account and provider eligibility. Kuwait support unverified.
platforms.accountKyc: Human signup/email verification/profile, link GitHub, accept current terms personally, configure supported payout provider and identity/business verification. No account or API key required for public read-only catalogue.
ownerStepsIfLaterAdded: Create/verify Gitpay account and link correct GitHub username.
Complete skills/profile and review platform/repository AI policy.
Check supported payout method for actual residence with provider, then complete identity/bank setup privately.
Approve individual assignment request before coding; await GitHub assignee and Gitpay confirmation.
